title: Creator Courses: Selling Dreams as Products
summary: First-hand review of several creator and business courses: mostly recycled public advice, referral programs drive the reviews, and course sales are the real income.

assertions.quote: you can easily find on YouTube or Reddit faster than it would take to sign up for this website
they incentivize positive reviews and promotion through their referral program, which is why you rarely see any negative reviews
his own business made $0 and he's teaching you how to become a millionaire by starting your own business

verdicts.note: Documented cases are common but not universal; some course sellers do run real operating businesses.

The FTC alleges the Automators founders falsely promoted themselves as self-made ecommerce millionaires who helped thousands generate tens of millions, and falsely claimed venture-capital backing; one instance of a fabricated track record.

assertions.quote: a few others that were already doing pretty well before taking his course
the key to success is becoming a creator. A creator of courses.
This is how to become a salesman for Amazon products.

verdicts.note: Observed in several reviewed courses, but it is one reviewer's sample.
